responsibility: Implements the low-level Euler-tour forest dynamic-tree data structure used by GCC’s dominance subsystem for efficient ancestor, root, split, and nearest-common-ancestor queries on changing trees. It manages `et_node` and occurrence objects with splay-based path representations, supports linking nodes under fathers, splitting parent-child relationships, answering `et_nca`, `et_below`, and `et_root`, and includes selftests for those invariants. Its role is infrastructural: it provides the dynamic tree backend on which fast dominance queries and updates are built.
same_name_distinction: Implements the Euler-tour forest operations declared in gcc/et-forest.h, including the splay-tree-based dynamic-tree mechanics for link/split/root/NCA/ancestor queries and the file-local selftests for those invariants.
